root_facts: A cancelled case with an effective refund obligation of TWD 1000.
A valid bank outgoing fact of TWD 600, followed by a valid bank outgoing fact of TWD 400.
A separate valid refund reversal root for the fully refunded state.
forbidden_direct_seed: refund transaction, allocation, summary or alert rows
orders status derived by the cancellation reducer
commands: Run refund preview for the TWD 600 outgoing fact.
Apply the TWD 600 outgoing fact through the owning Client Finance workflow.
Apply the TWD 400 recovery outgoing fact through the same workflow.
Apply the valid reversal through the owning Client Finance workflow.
expected: Preview defaults to one exact remaining settlement and identifies TWD 600 as an underpayment exception.
The first Apply produces partially_refunded with remaining TWD 400; it is a recovery state, not a planned instalment state.
The second Apply produces refunded with remaining TWD 0 and preserves both immutable bank facts.
The reversal reopens the progress state from effective remaining money without deleting history.
Every Apply has typed API and UI expectations plus row-delta, replay and anomaly assertions.
receipt_requirements: refund progress and review state transitions
typed API and UI result snapshots
